example: The mother who bashed her child on the head with a club was criticized by the public.
example_zh: 那個用棍棒猛擊孩子頭部的媽媽遭受大眾的批評。
memory_hint: bash 表重擊、猛擊。

example: The opera star that is going to give a performance tonight is a fine bass.
example_zh: 今晚要表演的歌劇明星是優秀的男低音歌手。
memory_hint: bass 指低音或男低音歌手。

example: She left all her fortune to her bastard
example_zh: which peeved her husband.
chinese: 她把所有的財產都留給了私生子，這讓她丈夫很生氣。
page: bastard 為貶義詞，原義私生子。

example: With batch files
example_zh: which are also called batch programs
chinese: one can simplify routine or repetitive tasks.
synonyms: 利用批次檔案，又稱批次處理程式，可以簡化例行或重複性的任務。
memory_hint: bunch; cluster

example: A battalion is generally the smallest military unit which is capable of independent operations.
example_zh: 營通常是軍隊裡最小的組織單位，能夠獨立作戰。
memory_hint: battalion 指軍隊中的營級單位。

example: The police battered down the door but found that the criminal had already gone.
example_zh: 員警把門猛力打開，卻發現罪犯已經逃走了。
memory_hint: batter 表連續猛擊。

example: He is bearish about the stock market.
example_zh: 他看跌股市。
memory_hint: bearish 在金融語境常指看跌的。

example: The beaten army refused to surrender.
example_zh: 被打敗的軍隊拒絕投降。
chinese: 踏平的；挨打的；筋疲力盡的
memory_hint: beaten 可表示被擊敗的，也可指筋疲力盡的。

example: The garden looked very bedraggled after the storm.
example_zh: 院子在暴風雨過後看起來又濕又髒。
memory_hint: bedraggled 指又濕又髒、凌亂的。

example: The computers in this studio beep regularly.
example_zh: 這個工作室的電腦發出有規律的嗶嗶聲。
memory_hint: beep 表發出短促嗶聲。

example: Beet sells well this year.
example_zh: 甜菜在今年很好賣。
memory_hint: beet 指甜菜。

example: They put up the proposal on your behalf
example_zh: but now you blame them.
chinese: 他們代表你提出了這個建議，但是現在你責備他們。
page: on behalf of 表代表、為了…的利益。

example: Her happy manner belied her real feelings.
example_zh: 她那高興的樣子掩飾了她真實的感情。
memory_hint: belie 指使表面印象與真相不符。

example: Don't belittle yourself unduly.
example_zh: 你不要妄自菲薄。
memory_hint: belittle 表貶低、輕視。

example: He is bellicose in nature.
example_zh: 他的本性是好鬥的。
memory_hint: bellicose 指好戰、好鬥。

example: We showed high respect to those benefactors.
example_zh: 我們對那些捐助者表達了崇高的敬意。
memory_hint: benefactor 指施恩者、捐助者。

example: He is the beneficiary of your generosity.
example_zh: 他是你慷慨解囊的受益人。
memory_hint: beneficiary 指從某事獲益的人。

example: The school received a benevolent donation.
example_zh: 學校接受了一筆慈善捐款。
memory_hint: benevolent 指仁慈、慈善的。

example: Don't worry. Your mother's growth is benign.
example_zh: 不要擔心，你母親的腫瘤是良性的。
memory_hint: benign 可指仁慈的，也可指腫瘤良性的。

example: His collection of paintings was bequeathed to the National Gallery.
example_zh: 他所有的藏畫都遺贈給了國家美術館。
memory_hint: bequeath 指以遺囑留下財產。

example: Besieged with fears
example_zh: she decided to have a long holiday in the countryside.
chinese: 她因恐懼而煩擾，所以決定到鄉下度個長假。
page: besiege 可指軍事包圍，也可比喻困擾。

example: The trophy was bestowed upon the winner.
example_zh: 獎品頒給了優勝者。
memory_hint: bestow A upon B 表把 A 贈與 B。

example: This alcoholic beverage with a concentration of more than 40% ethanol is not suitable for teenagers.
example_zh: 這種酒精度超過40%的酒精飲料不適合青少年飲用。
memory_hint: beverage 指飲料。

example: Bewildered by their explanation
example_zh: I decided to find out the truth for myself.
chinese: 我被他們的解釋弄糊塗了，所以決定自己去探究事實真相。

example: You should list your bibliographies at the end of your essay.
example_zh: 你應該把參考書目列在報告的最後。
memory_hint: bibliography 指參考書目。

example: We are willing to offer you an opportunity to develop bilateral trade.
example_zh: 我們願提供您一個發展雙邊貿易的機會。
memory_hint: bilateral 指雙邊的、兩方面的。

example: They signed an agreement which was binding on both parties.
example_zh: 他們簽訂了一份對雙方都有約束力的協議。
chinese: 捆綁的；黏合的；有約束力的
memory_hint: binding on 表對…具有約束力。
